استشرفوا (form X)

# اُسْتُشْرِفُوا (ustušrifū) /us.tuʃ.ri.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَشْرَفَ (istašrafa)
# اِسْتَشْرِفُوا (istašrifū) /is.taʃ.ri.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَشْرَفَ (istašrafa)
